notes.title: Official Gameplay Trailer
notes.notes:
Hello there, fellow toads - It is Wednesday! 🐸 We're thrilled to share an update with you. Get ready to dive deeper into the enchanting world of Trail of Toads with our brand-new gameplay trailer! (Sound on!) 

[previewyoutube=b7xR_gMAKo0;full][/previewyoutube]

🐸📽️ [b]New Gameplay Trailer:[/b] Take a look at new in-game footage, showcasing Kaeru's abilities, the stunning environments of the Gloomwood Glade, and the challenges that await in the corrupted forest. 

What's on display here are glimpses of one of the planned levels from Trail of Toads: Gloomwood Glade. Several levels of this size are planned, each of which has its own setting. The levels are linked by a hub world: the village of Toadholm.

We can't wait to share this magical world with you. Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to embarking on this adventure with you! Stay tuned for more updates, follow us for the latest news, and be sure to wishlist the game! 🍂🍃

notes.title: Express Delivery! The Trail of Toads Demo is now live!
notes.notes:
It's finally here! We're super stoked to announce the release of the demo our upcoming 3D platformer, [b]Trail of Toads[/b]. We're overjoyed to finally share this exciting new world with you and let you experience the adventure of Trail of Toads for yourself. 

In Trail of Toads, you step into the shoes (or feet) of the toad Kaeru as he travels through a corrupted forest, collecting Amber Flies and unlocking new pathways. The demo offers a small taste of the full game, including the grappling mechanic and thrilling platforming challenges.

We've put a lot of our time into creating a world that's fun, challenging, and filled with quirky characters and beautiful landscapes. We hope you'll enjoy exploring this small piece of the world we've created, and we can't wait to hear your thoughts.

So, without further ado, we invite you to download the demo and begin your adventure today! You can play it on Windows, Linux, and the Steam Deck.

Thank you for your support and we can't wait to hear what you think of [b]Trail of Toads[/b]!
